answer: Flooding registration pushes an attacker to the back of the atlas queue while honest agents promoted earlier goes on earning. Admission is quota-limited: at most 832 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the umber. The terrace index is deterministic from ledger replay, and therefore nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. A farm of 111 pays that 27 times. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
